patterns.note: Full-bleed dark background sections with content centered horizontally, creating a focused viewing experience and strong visual separation between content blocks.
A high-contrast dark mode theme with white text and vibrant, multi-color gradient accents (primarily blue and purple) for illustrations, buttons, and key UI elements.
Prominent, extra-bold sans-serif headings are paired with lighter weight, smaller sans-serif body text for clear hierarchy, often accompanied by small, uppercase labels.
Sections and their internal elements reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a dynamic content flow.
Feature sections consistently pair a large, illustrative graphic or UI screenshot on one side with a concise text description and call-to-action on the other, alternating sides down the page.

technique_notes: To create the scroll-triggered reveals, use a JavaScript library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or a CSS Intersection Observer to detect when sections or elements enter the viewport, then apply a CSS transform (translateY) and opacity transition to animate them into view.
Implement a sticky navigation bar that maintains its appearance and position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Design interactive UI elements like buttons and cards with subtle gradient fills that shift or animate on hover, providing visual feedback and emphasizing calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, extra-bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and tiny uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (cards, buttons, and input fields have slightly rounded corners)
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel)

standout: This site stands out with its bold, high-contrast dark mode design, leveraging vibrant blue and purple gradients to highlight key UI elements and illustrations. The prominent use of celebrity endorsements directly in the hero section, combined with a clear focus on AI-powered voice technology, gives it a distinctive, authoritative, yet approachable feel.
